newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY (PAGE 3/3 - FRIDAY-SUNDAY).
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY (PAGE 3/3 - FRIDAY-SUNDAY).

text.p: ROTTERDAM - Informal Social Affairs Council (and Saturday); discussions focus on unemployment.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (last of five days).
- John Tomlinson report on guarantees for EIB loans to Third Countries.
- Alain Pompidou report "Enhancing cooperation between emerging economies regarding RTD".
- Johanna Boogerd-Quaak on the demographic situation in the European Union.
LUXEMBOURG - Benelux Consultative Interparliamentary Council holds conference on the euro (1000/0900 GMT) (and Saturday). Speakers include: Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker.

APELDOORN, Netherlands - Informal General Affairs Council (1300/1200 GMT) (and Sunday). Discussions on how to proceed with negotiations with 10 former communist bloc countries that have been promised eventual EU membership.
ROTTERDAM - Informal Social Affairs Council continues (second of two days).
APELDOORN, Netherlands - Informal General Affairs Council continues (1000/0900 GMT) (second of two days). Discussion on Turkey and Cyprus.
